Name: Sizeable Sebastian
Author: PeriScribbles
Description:
Sebastian has always been my favorite bachelor, though I couldn't help but feel like something was missing...so I decided that something was dyed hair and piercings!...and an extra 300 pounds, give or take. Yeah this is very self-indulgent, but I know there's other FA's out there who would enjoy this mod just as much as I will, so I'm sharing it here!

Right now, all this mod does is edit Sebastian's appearance. His overworld sprites and portrait sprites have all been given a makeover, including his beach look and an all-new winter outfit! However, this is just laying the groundwork. I want this mod to be much bigger and more expansive (hah) so, following are a list of things that I want to include in the mod, roughly ordered in what's easiest to add to what will likely be months off.

> Unique Summer and Fall outfits (default will stay as Spring)
> Edit dialogue to reflect changes in both eating habits and personality
> Retool Sebastian's personality to be less mopey and more aligned with an invigorated punk attitude
> Create new recipes, and add the finished dishes to Sebastian's liked gifts
> Make additional events to center around feedism and/or his punk lifestyle
> Create a new storyline surrounding his home life and repairing his family relationships

UPDATES

v.1.0.1 - Minor fix to Sebastian's Winter Portraits
Those are all the ideas I've got for now, though this list already being a tall order I'm not sure there's much else I'd want (or should) add.

About compatibility, at least currently, I don't believe there are many issues? Though I did want to mention that:

> I wanted to back-door this mod to make it compatible with Diverse Stardew Valley. In my mod, both Sebastian's hair color and skin tone are based on it, and to make him consistent with both Vanilla and Diverse Stardew, here he's non-specified half-White half-Asian. When unique dialogue is added to the mod as well, I will also include instances where Sebastian is referred to as they (I intend for him to be unspecified nonbinary as well).

>This mod is and will always be marked as NSFW. While there's never going to be explicit sex on screen, I will be marking it as NSFW anyway since it is kink focused and the mod will in the future have scenes all about stuffing Sebastian to the gills.

> I wanted to mention I was inspired by Pixel3r's Really Heavy Sebby mod! Both because I still wanted Sebastian bigger than he was in that mod, but also for the idea of replacing his smoking sprites with him chugging joja cola instead!
